ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #8 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which sound does the Arabic letter ز make? (1 mark)
   A. z as in zebra
   B. t as in tap
   C. k as in kite
   D. j as in jug

2. How do you read the syllable لِ? (1 mark)
   A. li
   B. muu
   C. ti
   D. qaa

3. How do you read the syllable مِ? (1 mark)
   A. nu
   B. mi
   C. da
   D. buu

4. Which pair of syllables makes the word ukhtun (sister)? (1 mark)
   A. ukh + tun
   B. khu + ta
   C. tun + a
   D. bin + tun

5. Which Arabic word means "mother's sister"? (1 mark)
   A. خَالَةٌ
   B. أُسْرَةٌ
   C. جَدَّةٌ
   D. أَبٌ

6. What does the word يَا (yaa) do in مَرْحَبًا يَا أَحْمَدُ? (1 mark)
   A. It means 'my'
   B. It calls a person, like 'O' or 'hey'
   C. It means 'and'
   D. It means 'in'

7. Which Arabic word means "garden"? (1 mark)
   A. حَدِيقَةٌ
   B. حَقِيبَةٌ
   C. سَاعَةٌ
   D. بَيْتٌ

8. Which Arabic word means "house"? (1 mark)
   A. نَافِذَةٌ
   B. بَيْتٌ
   C. حَمَّامٌ
   D. كُوبٌ

9. Which sentence means 'I visit my grandmother on Friday'? (1 mark)
   A. azuuru jaddatii yawma l-jumuʿa
   B. usaaʿidu ummii yawma s-sabt
   C. alʿabu yawma s-sabt
   D. aqraʾu kitaaban yawma l-ahad

10. What does the Arabic sentence أَزُورُ جَدَّتِي يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I help my mother on Saturday.
   B. I drink water.
   C. I read a book on Sunday.
   D. I visit my grandmother on Friday.

11. What does the little word li- mean in li-Aminata? (1 mark)
   A. in
   B. on
   C. and
   D. for

12. Which Arabic word means "festival"? (1 mark)
   A. عِيدٌ
   B. حَلْوَى
   C. رَقْصٌ
   D. لَا

13. What does the Arabic sentence الْمَاءُ مُفِيدٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I like food.
   B. Water is useful (good for you).
   C. The juice is cold.
   D. The fish is delicious.

14. When you time a friend reading, what matters most? (1 mark)
   A. Reading in a whisper
   B. Steady pace with correct words
   C. Ignoring punctuation
   D. Being the fastest

15. Which Arabic sentence means "I have two eyes." (1 mark)
   A. لِي يَدَانِ
   B. هَذَا جِسْمِي
   C. لِي عَيْنَانِ
   D. جِسْمِي قَوِيٌّ

16. What does the Arabic sentence جِسْمِي قَوِيٌّ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have two hands.
   B. I have two eyes.
   C. My body is strong.
   D. This is my body.

17. How is the Arabic word غَائِمٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. shams
   B. mushmis
   C. haarr
   D. ghaa'im

18. What does maa ajmala l-bii'a mean? (1 mark)
   A. I plant a tree.
   B. The rain is heavy.
   C. Where is the environment?
   D. How beautiful the environment is!

19. What goes on the back of a vocabulary flashcard? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. The sound and the meaning
   C. A long story
   D. Only the date

20. Which Arabic word means "behind"? (1 mark)
   A. بِجَانِبِ
   B. عَلَى
   C. أَمَامَ
   D. خَلْفَ

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Name the four marks (harakat) that show short vowels or no vowel and say what each one shows. (4 marks) (4 marks)

22. Read these words and write their sounds in English letters with meanings: مَرْحَبًا and شُكْرًا. (4 marks) (4 marks)

23. Translate into English: azuuru jaddatii yawma l-jumuʿa (2 marks)

24. Read these sentences and give the day for each activity: (a) adhhabu ilaa l-madrasa yawma l-ithnayn (b) alʿabu yawma s-sabt (c) aqraʾu kitaaban yawma l-ahad. (3 marks) (3 marks)

25. Write the Arabic sounds for 'two hands' and 'two legs' and give the meaning of each ending. (3 marks) (3 marks)

26. Translate into English: maa ajmala l-bii'a (2 marks)

27. Give two reasons why reading is important. (2 marks) (2 marks)

28. Translate into English: haadhihi hafla (2 marks)

29. Translate into English: jismii qawiyy (2 marks)

30. Translate into English: usaaʿidu ummii yawma s-sabt. (2 marks) (2 marks)

31. Read the sentence اسْمِي أَحْمَدُ and write its meaning. (2 marks) (2 marks)

32. Translate into English: usaaʿidu ummii yawma s-sabt (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #8 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — z as in zebra
   The letter ز makes the sound z as in zebra.

2. A — li
   لِ is read li.

3. B — mi
   مِ is read mi.

4. A — ukh + tun
   ukh-tun is the word for sister.

5. A — خَالَةٌ
   خَالَةٌ (khaala) means mother's sister.

6. B — It calls a person, like 'O' or 'hey'
   yaa is used to call someone by name.

7. A — حَدِيقَةٌ
   حَدِيقَةٌ (hadiiqa) means garden.

8. B — بَيْتٌ
   بَيْتٌ (bayt) means house.

9. A — azuuru jaddatii yawma l-jumuʿa
   azuuru means I visit and jaddatii means my grandmother.

10. D — I visit my grandmother on Friday.
   أَزُورُ جَدَّتِي يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ (azuuru jaddatii yawma l-jumuʿa) means: I visit my grandmother on Friday.

11. D — for
   li- means 'for', so li-Aminata is 'for Amina'.

12. A — عِيدٌ
   عِيدٌ (ʿiid) means festival.

13. B — Water is useful (good for you).
   الْمَاءُ مُفِيدٌ (al-maa'u mufiid) means: Water is useful (good for you).

14. B — Steady pace with correct words
   Timing helps pace, but accuracy and smoothness matter most.

15. C — لِي عَيْنَانِ
   لِي عَيْنَانِ (lii ʿaynaani) means: I have two eyes.

16. C — My body is strong.
   جِسْمِي قَوِيٌّ (jismii qawiyy) means: My body is strong.

17. D — ghaa'im
   غَائِمٌ is read ghaa'im and means cloudy.

18. D — How beautiful the environment is!
   maa ajmala is a cry of wonder meaning 'how beautiful'.

19. B — The sound and the meaning
   The Arabic word is on the front. The back shows the sound and the meaning.

20. D — خَلْفَ
   خَلْفَ (khalfa) means behind.

SECTION B
----
21. (4 marks)
   Answer: fatHa gives a, kasra gives i, Damma gives u, and sukuun shows no vowel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each mark and its meaning.

22. (4 marks)
   Answer: mar-ha-ban (hello) and shuk-ran (thank you).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct reading and 1 mark for each meaning.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: I visit my grandmother on Friday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: (a) Monday (b) Saturday (c) Sunday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct match.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: yadaani (two hands) and rijlaani (two legs). The ending -aani means two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word and 1 mark for the ending.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: How beautiful the environment is!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: It helps us to learn new words and information, and it gives us enjoyment.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible reason.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is a party.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: My body is strong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: I help my mother on Saturday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for 'I help my mother' and 1 mark for 'on Saturday'.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: ismii Ahmad. My name is Ahmad.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for reading and 1 mark for meaning.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: I help my mother on Saturday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.
